doc: docs/ui-design-system.md section 15.2: the Why card's second line per whyline reason code (what would change the decision). Same {param} names as whyline.json; a code without an entry shows no second line.

codes.quest_step: A higher level or an order from you moves me off the quest path.
codes.walk: An order from you, or a level up that opens a better area, changes where I go.
codes.fight: Life under my retreat line sends me to town; an order from you ends the fight sooner.
codes.town_trip: Nothing changes this trip; I head out again when the chores are done.
codes.town_chores: Once the chores are done I go back out; an order from you picks where.
codes.heal_trip: Healing above {line}% sends me back out.
codes.wait_heal: A potion, a healer or time back above my line ends the wait.
codes.claim_trip: Once the reward is claimed I go back to the plan.
codes.back_to_field: An order from you would send me somewhere else first.
codes.to_town: An order from you gives me something to do outside.
codes.area_done: An order from you to stay would keep me here.
codes.guard_exit: A higher level or better gear makes this area safe again.
codes.farm_runs: An order from you, or enough of what I farm, ends the runs.
codes.farm_gold: Enough gold for what I need ends the farming.
codes.saving_for: Once the gold covers it I shop for it; selling loot gets there sooner.
codes.after_death_restock: Once restocked I go for my corpse.
codes.after_death_corpse: Once my corpse is back I return to the plan.
codes.after_death_gold: Once the spot is checked I return to the plan.
codes.player_items: Once the queued item actions are done I go back to the plan; you can cancel a queued one on the inventory page.
codes.hold: Your answer, yes or no, lets me go on.
codes.activity: An order from you changes what I do next.
